# Test int
cfg = load_config({'port': 80, 'host': 'x'}, {'APP_PORT': '8080'})
assert cfg == {'port': 8080, 'host': 'x'}, f'Failed int: {cfg}'

# Test float
cfg = load_config({'rate': 1.5}, {'APP_RATE': '2.5'})
assert cfg == {'rate': 2.5}, f'Failed float: {cfg}'

# Test bool
cfg = load_config({'debug': False}, {'APP_DEBUG': 'true'})
assert cfg == {'debug': True}, f'Failed bool: {cfg}'

# Test str
cfg = load_config({'name': 'default'}, {'APP_NAME': 'new'})
assert cfg == {'name': 'new'}, f'Failed str: {cfg}'

# Test no override
cfg = load_config({'port': 80}, {})
assert cfg == {'port': 80}, f'Failed no override: {cfg}'

# Test non-APP_ keys ignored
cfg = load_config({'port': 80}, {'OTHER': '8080'})
assert cfg == {'port': 80}, f'Failed non-APP_ ignored: {cfg}'

print('All manual tests passed')
"
